scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && ./gradlew bundleRelease) && mkdir -p ../../../../../dist/apps/android && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../../../../dist/apps/android/flypc-mobile.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../../../../../dist/apps/android/flypc-mobile.aab
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && mkdir -p ../../../../../dist/apps/ios && echo "Open ios/App/App.xcworkspace in Xcode and export IPA to ../../../../../dist/apps/ios" > ../../../../../dist/apps/ios/README.txt
